data_description.url: The address you open Homebox at, for example {example_url}
data_description.api_token: Create one in Homebox under your profile, API keys
data_description.printer: The label printer that prints the tags

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Homebox at that URL.

data_description.default_icon: Added to every tag unless an icon is given when printing. Leave empty for none.

print_tags.name: Print Homebox tags
print_tags.description: Looks up Homebox items, boxes or locations and prints an asset tag for each (QR link, asset ID, name) on the configured printer. Returns the matched items.

asset_ids.name: Asset IDs
asset_ids.description: Asset IDs to print, such as 000-042 or just 42.

search.name: Search
search.description: Print every item whose name matches. Leave empty to match everything.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: MDI icon for these tags; overrides the default tag icon.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only return the matching items; don't print.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: What goes on the tag besides the QR code. Defaults to the Tag layout setting.

config_entry_id.name: Homebox
config_entry_id.description: Which Homebox connection, if you have several.
